sections.label: TOOL CALL: python
sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Check current state
seg = current_frame.segmentation
nodes = seg['nodes']
r_nodes = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'R']
print(f"Red nodes: {len(r_nodes)}")
for r in r_nodes:
    rows = [p[0] for p in r['boundary']]
    cols = [p[1] for p in r['boundary']]
    center_row = sum(rows) // len(rows)
    center_col = sum(cols) // len(cols)
    print(f"  R at ({center_row}, {center_col}), pixels={r['pixels']}")

# Sort red blocks by position (top-left to bottom-right)
r_positions = []
for r in r_nodes:
    rows = [p[0] for p in r['boundary']]
    cols = [p[1] for p in r['boundary']]
    center_row = sum(rows) // len(rows)
    center_col = sum(cols) // len(cols)
    r_positions.append((center_row, center_col, r['id']))
r_positions.sort()
print(f"\nSorted red positions: {r_positions}")

# Click on all red blocks in order
for row, col, rid in r_positions:
    print(f"Clicking red {rid} at ({row}, {col})")
    result = action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': row, 'col': col}])
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    nodes = seg['nodes']
    color_counts = {}
    for n in nodes:
        color_counts[n['color']] = color_counts.get(n['color'], 0) + n['pixels']
    print(f"  After: {color_counts}, level_completed={result.get('level_completed')}")
    if result.get('level_completed'):
        print("LEVEL COMPLETED!")
        break
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
